notes: CONTIGUITY: d-bar over the 283 pairs at mushaf gap >= 10 sits at the 5.25th percentile against 5.07 unrestricted -- the whole-set clustering is NOT adjacency.

CONTIGUITY: Delta halves at gap >= 2 and reverses sign at gap >= 10, where only ALM contributes a within-class pair.
The N_PERIOD matched null overlaps the observed 29 by 16.32 members on average (56.3%); every matched NULL here is weak evidence of absence.
FAM_c_registered is size-confounded (rho=+0.838 with run mean log word count) and is superseded by size_conditional_adjacency_p_posthoc.
The hawamim are the contiguous mushaf run 40-46; 47.5-52.0% of matched baseline partitions reach the Quran's own value at the same slots.
Not an independent confirmation of Pillar 1 under any label: same 29 surahs, same corpus.
